positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on back-end application and API development for the Square Online merchant platform. 

• Present during a period of a 10x scaling of the ECOM engineering team within 4 years.
• Helped drive scaling of the Square Online merchant platform from 600 storefronts to 250,000 storefronts within 4 years.
• Responsible for keeping the online stores running at significant scale, handling thousands of transactions per day. This included regular weekly on-call rotations.
• Collaborated with multiple teams across Square on various features, including Square Pay, On-Demand Delivery, and Recurring Subscriptions Checkout.
• Provided technical designs and reviews for various projects within ECOM, paricularly focused on shopping cart, checkout, and payment flows. 
• Handled integrations and troubleshooting with other 3rd party services like Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.
• Led the ECOM Brownbags Presentation Program, which allowed ECOM engineers to introduce new dev-focused learning topics to a larger audience within Square.
• Back-end stack: Laravel/Eloquent/MySQL/Elasticsearch
• Front-end stack: Vue/Vuex

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Acquired by Square in May, 2018.

Worked on full stack application and API development for the e-commerce team. 

• One of 12 initial hires to help develop and scale out their new e-commerce platform as a set of microservices.
• Responsible for keeping the Weebly online stores running at scale, handling thousands of transactions per day. This included regular weekly on-call rotations.
• Collaborated with multiple teams on various features, including checkout flows, digital payments, fulfillments, and analytics.
• Handled integrations and troubleshooting with other 3rd party services like Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Shippo.
• Back-end stack: Laravel/Eloquent/MySQL/Elasticsearch
• Front-end stack: Vue/Vuex

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Worked with an early-stage healthcare startup to bring their mobile-focused urgent care product from concept to soft launch.

• Defined and implemented the platform API using open-source technologies and integration of third-party web services.
•  Defined and implemented the data architecture used for the application and back-end business processes.
•  Defined and implemented the build and deployment process using cloud-based technologies and continuous integration. 
•  Collaborated with CTO and business team to define product and feature milestones.
•  Trained and mentored developers and participated in code reviews.
• Back-end stack: Python/PostgreSQL/Solr
• Front-end stack: React

positions.title: Engineering Lead, Mobile API Team
positions.description:
Led the team responsible for building and maintaining APIs to support Trulia’s native mobile apps (iOS, Android) and data pipelines.

•  Drove the migration from a home-grown monolithic web stack to a service-oriented architecture built on open-source frameworks. 
•  Designed and implemented new business-critical web services in coordination with internal/remote dev and operations teams.
•  Introduced a common API framework and evangelized it to other development teams, providing guidance on building their own web services.
•  Managed and prioritized weekly releases for new app features in coordination with mobile product and marketing teams.
•  Improved engineering success, engagement, and stability by introducing TDD and standardized deployment processes to team.
•  Trained and mentored developers and participated in code reviews.
• Back-end stack: PHP/MySQL/Solr
• Front-end stack: Backbone

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Built and maintained web sites, tools, and APIs used to support their digital music distribution business. 
  
•  Drove refactoring projects which migrated legacy web applications to a new standards-based MVC architecture.
•  Re-architected customer dashboard application to focus on componentized libraries, performance, and stability. 
•  Worked with data engineers to define and build SOA for ingesting customer metadata and audio content.
•  Launched public API to expose all publicly accessible metadata for customers and third-party service integrations. 
•  Selected as core transition team member when migrating code and data during the Orchard merger/acquisition.
• Back-end stack: Zend/MySQL
• Front-end stack: JQuery

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Founding team member of a startup company working on personalized video search products. 

•  Draper Fisher Jurvetson led our Series A. 
•  Our company was showcased at Techcrunch Disrupt 2008.
•  Worked with the core team to take the product from conception through launch.
•  Prototyped and launched a version of the product for the WII gaming platform.
•  Managed multiple aspects of product engineering, infrastructure, and hiring.
•  Collaborated with CEO and other founders to define company branding, mission statement, and internal processes.
• Back-end stack: PHP/MySQL
• Front-end stack: JQuery/Javascript
